::: {.callout-tip}
## Growth Mindset

A **growth mindset** is the belief that intelligence, abilities, and talents can be developed through effort and persistence—not fixed traits you're born with.

In {{< meta params.course-code >}}, you'll encounter challenging concepts that may initially seem overwhelming. **This is normal and expected: it means you're learning.**

In practice, that means revisiting mistakes, reworking hard problems, asking questions when you're stuck, and giving yourself time to improve instead of treating confusion as failure.

Trust the process, embrace the challenge, and discover that you're capable of doing hard things.
:::
